sources.title: WanVideo_comfy: Image-to-Video model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview WanVideo_comfy is an image-to-video generation model maintained by Kijai as a combined and quantized version of WanVideo from Wan-AI. The model runs through ComfyUI using either the dedicated WanVideoWrapper or ComfyUI native nodes. This package provides multiple quantization options including standard fp32 and experimental fp8_scaled variants to balance quality against memory ...
